payload.text: At devbin 0.1.20's sweep, for 0323 bank 2 (landed 89380aa5): Utilz is the one project on the built-in macos, and it declares macos.keychain, which 0.1.20 refuses as an unknown key. In Utilz's sweep commit vc drops keychain: from its macos block (directive 10). Tell utilz-vc at its next session that notarisation moves to one notarytool keychain profile, macos.notary_profile (default devbin). macos.team picks the signing identity and is required where the keychain holds more than one Developer ID identity. Before Utilz's next cut, hv runs bin/devbin macos store-creds once on each Mac that cuts, and macos doctor then reads the profile PRESENT. The old keychain items stay where they are, since nothing deletes them.
